purpose: Verify delete refuses while dependants exist, cascades cleanly, and removes unreferenced leaves leaving the tree valid.
title: Delete with reference safety

testCases.description: delete without cascade refuses with exit 4 naming dependents
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/delete.test.js::rcf delete REQ-001 without --cascade refuses with exit 4

testCases.description: cascade delete removes the sub-tree files leaving the tree valid
